info.title: bConnect Server Management API
info.description:
The methods offered here provide support for configurations of the baramundi Management Server.
Well known GUIDs: [Administration profile: 41601841-0DA2-4EF1-B810-D72E6231CF1B ] The bConnect V2 PowerShell module is available from the PowerShell Gallery.

404.description: Missing read rights for DIP management

post.summary: Simulates the cleanup of the Master DIP regarding managed software files

200.description: Returns a list of files that would be deleted

403.description: Missing modify rights for Managed Software settings

423.description: Simulation or cleanup is already running

post.summary: Performs cleanup of the Master DIP regarding managed software files

200.description: Performs cleanup and returns a value indicating the success

403.description: Missing modify rights for Managed Software settings

423.description: Simulation or cleanup is already running

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description: Sorts results by property name and with sort direction. Multiple properties are separated by comma. Possible values are Name or LastExecution (e. g. Name asc).

parameters.name: SearchQuery
parameters.description: Filters results by matching the given value against searchable properties. Searchable values are Name and LocalPathName.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Filters result by matching the exact value against Name.

parameters.name: LastExecution
parameters.description: Filters on lastExecution. Date values have to be specified in ISO 8601 format. They can be filtered by adding the prefix 'lt' or 'gt' (e.g. gt 2023-07-28T08:01:03.375Z).

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The zero-indexed number of the first page that begins the set of pages that are returned in the response.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of items to list on a single page. For example, if page_size is 10, each page shows ten items.
A valid value is a non-negative, non-zero integer. The default value is 20. Maximum value is 1000.

patch.summary: Updates the modifiable values of the specified object permission

requestBody.description:
A JSON Patch document consists of a set of operations that allow specific partial changes to an object. The example document contains all modifiable object permission properties.

Initialize patch operations in PowerShell with `Initialize-bCPatchOperation`

400.description: The specified values to be modified are invalid

200.description: Returns the new values of the object permission with the specified id

403.description: No permission to modify the values of the object permission with the specified id

404.description: The specified object permission can not be found
